name: chronoglobe
description: ChronoGlobe browser game release checks and smoke tests

scripts.preflight: node tools/release-preflight.js && node tools/verify-weekly-workflow.js && node tools/verify-production-dependencies.js && node tools/verify-release-metadata.js && node tools/verify-security-policy.js && node tools/verify-release-readiness-contract.js && node tools/verify-runtime-loading.js
scripts.test: npm run preflight && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:smoke: npm run preflight && playwright test tests/smoke.spec.js
scripts.test:mobile: npm run preflight && playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.js
scripts.test:diagnostics: npm run preflight && playwright test tests/diagnostics.spec.js
